about: CI cost manifest (ci-spend law, 2026-10-11). One entry per workflow, one leg per runner OS. scripts/check_workflow_runner_cost.py fails a workflow or OS leg without an entry, an entry without a benefit, triggers/crons/jobs that differ from the workflow file, $ that do not add up, a repo total over repo_share_usd, and (locally, with sibling repos beside it) a sum over the weekly ceiling.
prices_source: GitHub billing API pricePerUnit (Actions Linux / Windows / macOS 3-core), read 2026-10-11

ci.yml.benefit: Extension build/lint/tests on every push and PR; macOS resource-guard integration.
ci.yml.owner_reason: Before it, nothing was enforced on PRs (AUDIT P0-8).
ci.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): ~2500 runs/week; sampled Linux 3.2 min, macOS 1.5 min

focused-acceptance.yml.benefit: Newest relevant main commit's focused acceptance, outside the CI queue.
focused-acceptance.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 466/week x 1 min

hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.benefit: Native side-panel acceptance on a hosted Mac guest, including EXT-D-0217 retained-profile Save/Retry and EXT-D-0221 admin Screenshots T04/T05 on the existing guarded lane; no extra job or schedule.
hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.owner_reason: Extension acceptance on a real browser.
hosted-guest-acceptance.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09: 288 dispatches/week x 4.8 macOS min; allow one additional on-demand D221 Screenshots run/week on the same runner, budgeted at 8 min. Blended 289 runs x 4.81 min; incremental gross ~$0.50/week; standard public runner billed $0.

hosted-resource-diagnostic.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 1/week x 2 macOS min

release.yml.benefit: Hosted release: publishes main and the immutable v* tag with the Store ZIP.
release.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 13/week x 5 min
